ex.en: The new stadium is a gigantic structure that can hold sixty thousand fans.
ex.zh: 新体育场是一座可容纳六万名观众的巨型建筑。

words.note: gigantic 由 giant（巨人）加 -ic 构成，比 huge 更夸张。

ex.en: Her writing style is quite distinct from that of her sister.
ex.zh: 她的写作风格与她姐姐的截然不同。

words.note: distinct 常与 from 连用，强调区别；distinctive 强调特色。

ex.en: Thick vegetation covered the hillside soon after the rainy season began.
ex.zh: 雨季开始后不久，茂密的植被就覆盖了山坡。

words.note: vegetation 是不可数名词，指一地草木总称；单株植物用 plant。

ex.en: Doctors say she will make a full recovery within a few weeks.
ex.zh: 医生说她在几周内就能完全康复。

words.note: recovery 后接 from 表示从…中恢复；动词 recover 比名词少个 -y。

ex.en: He studied geology at university and now works for an oil company.
ex.zh: 他在大学学地质学，现在为一家石油公司工作。

words.note: geo- 表示地球，-logy 表示学科，geology 即研究地球的学问。

ex.en: The workers used a crane to hoist the steel beams into place.
ex.zh: 工人们用起重机把钢梁吊装到位。

words.note: hoist 强调用绳索或机械向上吊起，比 raise 更具体。

ex.en: Few people were aware of the risks involved in the project.
ex.zh: 很少有人意识到这个项目涉及的风险。

words.note: aware 只作表语，常用 be aware of 或 that 从句。

ex.en: She bought a quart of milk and a loaf of bread on her way home.
ex.zh: 她在回家路上买了一夸脱牛奶和一条面包。

words.note: quart 是容量单位，一夸脱约合 0.95 升，多见于美式用法。

ex.en: The report presents the results in both numerical and written form.
ex.zh: 报告以数字和文字两种形式呈现结果。

words.note: numerical 修饰数据或顺序；in numerical order 意为按数字顺序。

ex.en: He limped off the field after twisting his ankle in the second half.
ex.zh: 下半场扭伤脚踝后，他一瘸一拐地走下球场。

words.note: limp 作动词指跛行，作形容词指松软无力，区别于 lame。

ex.en: Airport security has been tightened since the new rules took effect.
ex.zh: 新规定生效以来，机场安检更加严格。

words.note: security 指安全措施或保障；复数 securities 常指证券。

ex.en: The young scientist was awarded a prize for her research on batteries.
ex.zh: 这位年轻科学家因电池研究获奖。

words.note: award 可接双宾语：award sb sth，即授给某人某物。

ex.en: He took a part-time job to make a few extra bucks during the summer.
ex.zh: 他夏天做兼职，想多挣几个钱。

words.note: buck 在美式口语中指美元，make a buck 意为谋生赚钱。

ex.en: Only students who have finished the course are eligible for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 只有修完课程的学生才有资格申请奖学金。

words.note: eligible 后常接 for 或 to do；反义词是 ineligible。

ex.en: The fire alarm went off at midnight and everyone left the building.
ex.zh: 火警警报在午夜响起，所有人都撤出了大楼。

words.note: alarm 指警报或警报器；raise the alarm 意为发出警报。

ex.en: The patient was too feeble to walk without help after the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后病人太虚弱，无人搀扶就走不了路。

words.note: feeble 常形容人、声音或借口，比 weak 更带贬义。

ex.en: The manager gives each employee an annual performance appraisal in December.
ex.zh: 经理每年十二月对每位员工做绩效评估。

words.note: appraisal 多用于正式评估或估价，动词是 appraise。

ex.en: Continual interruptions made it hard for her to finish the report.
ex.zh: 不断的打扰使她难以完成报告。

words.note: continual 指反复发生；continuous 指不间断连续，勿混用。

ex.en: She grows herbs and vegetables in a small garden behind the house.
ex.zh: 她在屋后的小园子里种香草和蔬菜。

words.note: herb 指香草或药草；英式读音 h 不发音，美式要读出 h。

ex.en: Her latest book is written in simple prose that anyone can enjoy.
ex.zh: 她的新书用平实的散文写成，人人都能读懂。

words.note: prose 是不可数名词，与 verse（诗歌）相对而言。

ex.en: The climber fell and hurt his limbs, but he refused to give up.
ex.zh: 攀登者摔下来伤了四肢，但仍拒绝放弃。

words.note: limb 可指四肢，也可指大树枝；out on a limb 指孤立无援。

ex.en: New students attend a week-long orientation before classes officially begin.
ex.zh: 正式开课前，新生要参加为期一周的入学介绍。

words.note: orientation 指方向、定位或迎新介绍；动词 orient 意为使适应。

ex.en: Light refreshments were served after the lecture in the hall.
ex.zh: 讲座结束后，大厅里供应了简单茶点。

words.note: refreshments 指活动上的茶点，表示此义时常用复数。

ex.en: After months of practice, she spoke English with real confidence at the meeting.
ex.zh: 练习几个月后，她在会上自信地讲英语。

words.note: confidence 后接 in 表示对…有信心；形容词是 confident。

ex.en: Critics say the new tax rules are arbitrary and unfair to small firms.
ex.zh: 批评者说新税法武断，对小公司不公平。

words.note: arbitrary 强调凭个人意愿、缺乏依据；名词是 arbitrariness。

ex.en: She was so intent on her work that she forgot to eat lunch.
ex.zh: 她太专注于工作，连午饭都忘了吃。

words.note: be intent on doing 意为专心做某事；intent 作名词指意图。

ex.en: Students should take part in class discussions instead of remaining passive.
ex.zh: 学生应参与课堂讨论，而不是一直被动听讲。

words.note: passive 与 active 相对；passive voice 指被动语态。

ex.en: Farmers here use less chemical fertilizer to protect the local river.
ex.zh: 这里的农民少用化肥，以保护当地的河流。

words.note: fertilizer 由 fertile（肥沃的）加 -ize、-er 构成，指肥料。

ex.en: Sales in May rose by ten percent compared with the corresponding month last year.
ex.zh: 与去年同期相比，五月份销售额增长了百分之十。

words.note: corresponding 表示相对应的；correspond 作动词指相符或通信。

ex.en: The witness took an oath to tell the truth before giving evidence.
ex.zh: 证人在作证前宣誓说实话。

words.note: oath 常用 take an oath；under oath 指已宣誓作证。
